103.6: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
103.7: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
103.8: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
103.9: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
103.10: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
103.11: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
103.12: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
103.13: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
103.14: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
103.15: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
103.16: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
103.17: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
103.18: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
103.19: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
103.20: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
103.21: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
103.22: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

104.1: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
104.2: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
104.3: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
104.4: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
104.5: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
104.6: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
104.7: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
104.8: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
104.9: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
104.10: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
104.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
104.12: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
104.13: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
104.14: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
104.15: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
104.16: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
104.17: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
104.18: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
104.19: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
104.20: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
104.21: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
104.22: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
104.23: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
104.24: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
104.25: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
104.26: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
104.27: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
104.28: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
104.29: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
104.30: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
104.31: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
104.32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
104.33: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
104.34: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
104.35: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!

105.1: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
105.2: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
105.3: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
105.4: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
105.5: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
105.6: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
105.7: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
105.8: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
105.9: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
105.10: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
105.11: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
105.12: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
105.13: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
105.14: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
105.15: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
105.16: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
105.17: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
105.18: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
105.19: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
105.20: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
105.21: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
105.22: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
105.23: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
105.24: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
105.25: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
105.26: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
105.27: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
105.28: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
105.29: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
105.30: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
105.31: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
105.32: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
105.33: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
105.34: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
105.35: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
105.36: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
105.37: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
105.38: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
105.39: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
105.40: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
105.41: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
105.42: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
105.43: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
105.44: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
105.45: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!

106.1: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
106.2: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
106.3: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
106.4: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
106.5: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
106.6: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
106.7: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
106.8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
106.9: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
106.10: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
106.11: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
106.12: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
106.13: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
106.14: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
106.15: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
106.16: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
106.17: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
106.18: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
106.19: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
106.20: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
106.21: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
106.22: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
106.23: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
106.24: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
106.25: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
106.26: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
106.27: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
106.28: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
106.29: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
106.30: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
106.31: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
106.32: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
106.33: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
106.34: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
106.35: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
106.36: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
106.37: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
106.38: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
106.39: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
106.40: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
106.41: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
106.42: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
106.43: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
106.44: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
106.45: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
106.46: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
106.47: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
106.48: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!

107.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
107.2: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
107.3: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
107.4: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
107.5: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
107.6: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
107.7: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
107.8: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
107.9: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
107.10: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
107.11: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
107.12: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
107.13: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
107.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
107.15: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
107.16: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
107.17: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
107.18: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
107.19: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
107.20: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
107.21: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
107.22: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
107.23: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
107.24: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
107.25: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
107.26: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
107.27: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
107.28: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
107.29: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
107.30: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
107.31: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
107.32: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
107.33: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
107.34: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
107.35: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
107.36: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
107.37: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
107.38: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
107.39: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
107.40: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
107.41: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
107.42: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
107.43: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.

108.1: A song. A Psalm of David.My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
108.2: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
108.3: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
108.4: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
108.5: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
108.6: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
108.7: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
108.8: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
108.9: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
108.10: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
108.11: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
108.12: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
108.13: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

109.1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.O God of my praise, be not silent.
109.2: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
109.3: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
109.4: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
109.5: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
109.6: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
109.7: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
109.8: May his days be few; may another take his position.
109.9: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
109.10: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
109.11: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
109.12: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
109.13: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
109.14: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
109.15: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
109.16: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
109.17: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
109.18: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
109.19: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
109.20: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
109.21: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
109.22: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
109.23: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
109.24: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
109.25: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
109.26: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
109.27: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
109.28: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
109.29: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
109.30: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
109.31: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.

110.1: A Psalm of David.The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
110.2: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
110.3: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
110.4: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
110.5: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
110.6: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
110.7: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.

111.1: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
111.2: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
111.3: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
111.4: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
111.5: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
111.6: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
111.7: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
111.8: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
111.9: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
111.10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!

112.1: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
112.2: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
112.3: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
112.4: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
112.5: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
112.6: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
112.7: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
112.8: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
112.9: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
112.10: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

113.1: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
113.2: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
113.3: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
113.4: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
113.5: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
113.6: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
113.7: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
113.8: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
113.9: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!

114.1: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
114.2: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
114.3: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
114.4: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
114.5: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
114.6: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
114.7: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
114.8: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!

115.1: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
115.2: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
115.3: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
115.5: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
115.6: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
115.7: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
115.8: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
115.9: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
115.10: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
115.11: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
115.12: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
115.13: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
115.14: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
115.15: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
115.16: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
115.17: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
115.18: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!

116.1: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
116.2: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
116.3: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
116.4: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
116.5: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
116.6: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
116.7: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
116.8: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
116.9: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
116.10: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
116.11: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
116.12: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
116.13: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
116.14: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
116.15: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
116.16: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
116.17: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
116.18: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
116.19: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

117.1: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
117.2: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!

118.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
118.2: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
118.3: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
118.4: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
118.5: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
118.6: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
118.7: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
118.8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
118.9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
118.10: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
118.11: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
118.12: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
118.13: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
118.14: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
118.15: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
118.16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
118.17: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
118.18: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
118.20: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
118.21: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
118.22: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
118.23: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
118.24: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
118.25: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
118.26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
118.27: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
118.28: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
118.29: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

119.1: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
119.2: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
119.3: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
119.4: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
119.5: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
119.6: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
119.7: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
119.8: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
119.9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
119.10: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
119.11: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
119.12: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
119.13: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
119.14: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
119.15: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
119.16: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
119.17: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
119.18: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
119.19: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
119.20: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
119.21: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
119.22: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
119.23: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
119.24: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
119.25: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
119.26: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
119.27: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
119.28: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
119.29: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
119.30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
119.31: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
119.32: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
119.33: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
119.34: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
119.35: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
119.36: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
119.37: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
119.38: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
119.39: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
119.40: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
119.41: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
119.42: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
119.43: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
119.44: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
119.45: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
119.46: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
119.47: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
119.48: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
119.49: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
119.50: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
119.51: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
119.52: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
119.53: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
119.54: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
119.55: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
119.56: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
119.57: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
119.58: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
119.59: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
119.60: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
119.61: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
119.62: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
119.63: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
119.64: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
119.65: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
119.66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
119.67: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
119.68: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
119.69: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
119.70: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
119.71: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
119.72: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
119.73: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
119.74: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
119.75: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
119.76: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
119.77: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
119.78: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
119.79: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
119.80: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
119.81: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
119.82: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
119.83: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
119.84: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
119.85: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
119.86: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
119.87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
119.88: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
119.89: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
119.90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
119.91: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
119.92: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
119.93: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
119.94: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
119.95: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
119.96: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
119.97: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
119.98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
119.99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
119.100: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
119.101: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
119.102: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
119.103: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
119.104: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
119.105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
119.106: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
119.107: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
119.108: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
119.109: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
119.110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
119.111: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
119.112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
119.113: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
119.114: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
119.115: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
119.116: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
119.117: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
119.118: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
119.119: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
119.120: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
119.121: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
119.122: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
119.123: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
119.124: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
119.125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
119.126: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
119.127: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
119.128: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
119.129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
119.130: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
119.131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
119.132: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
119.133: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
119.134: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
119.135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
119.136: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
119.137: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
119.138: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
119.139: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
119.140: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
119.141: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
119.142: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
119.143: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
119.144: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
119.145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
119.146: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
119.147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
119.148: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
119.149: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
119.150: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
119.151: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
119.152: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
119.153: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
119.154: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
119.155: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
119.156: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
119.157: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
119.158: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
119.159: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
119.160: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
119.161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
119.162: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
119.163: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
119.164: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
119.165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
119.166: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
119.167: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
119.168: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
119.169: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
119.170: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
119.171: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
119.172: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
119.173: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
119.174: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
119.175: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
119.176: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.

120.1: A song of ascents.In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
120.2: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
120.3: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
120.4: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
120.5: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
120.6: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
120.7: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.

121.1: A song of ascents.I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
121.2: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
121.3: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
121.4: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
121.5: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
121.6: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
121.7: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
121.8: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

122.1: A song of ascents. Of David.I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
122.2: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
122.3: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
122.4: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
122.5: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
122.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
122.7: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
122.8: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
122.9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.

123.1: A song of ascents.I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
123.2: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
123.3: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
123.4: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.

124.1: A song of ascents. Of David.If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
124.2: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
124.3: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
124.4: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
124.5: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
124.6: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
124.7: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
124.8: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

125.1: A song of ascents.Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
125.2: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
125.3: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
125.4: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
125.5: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

126.1: A song of ascents.When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
126.2: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
126.3: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
126.4: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
126.5: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
126.6: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.

127.1: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
127.2: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
127.3: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
127.4: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
127.5: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.

128.1: A song of ascents.Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
128.2: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
128.3: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
128.4: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
128.5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
128.6: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!

129.1: A song of ascents.Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
129.2: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
129.3: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
129.4: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
129.5: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
129.6: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
129.7: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
129.8: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”

130.1: A song of ascents.Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
130.2: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
130.3: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
130.4: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
130.5: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
130.6: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
130.7: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
130.8: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.

131.1: A song of ascents. Of David.My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
131.2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
131.3: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.

132.1: A song of ascents.O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
132.2: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
132.3: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
132.4: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
132.5: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob. ”
132.6: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
132.7: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
132.8: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
132.9: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
132.10: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
132.11: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
132.12: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
132.13: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
132.14: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
132.15: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
132.16: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
132.17: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
132.18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”

133.1: A song of ascents. Of David.Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
133.2: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
133.3: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

134.1: A song of ascents.Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
134.2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
134.3: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

135.1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
135.2: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
135.3: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
135.4: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
135.5: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
135.6: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
135.7: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
135.8: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
135.9: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
135.10: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
135.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
135.12: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
135.13: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
135.14: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
135.16: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
135.17: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
135.18: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
135.19: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
135.20: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
135.21: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

136.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.2: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.4: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.5: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.6: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.7: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
136.8: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
136.9: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.10: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
136.11: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
136.12: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.13: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
136.14: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
136.15: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.16: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.17: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
136.18: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
136.19: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
136.20: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
136.21: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
136.22: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.23: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
136.24: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.25: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
136.26: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.

137.1: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
137.2: There on the willows we hung our harps,
137.3: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
137.4: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
137.5: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
137.6: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
137.7: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
137.8: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
137.9: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

138.1: Of David.I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
138.2: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
138.3: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
138.4: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
138.5: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
138.6: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
138.7: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
138.8: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.

139.1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
139.2: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
139.3: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
139.4: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
139.5: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
139.6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
139.7: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
139.8: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
139.9: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
139.10: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
139.11: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
139.12: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
139.13: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
139.14: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
139.15: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
139.16: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
139.17: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
139.18: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
139.19: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
139.20: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
139.21: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
139.22: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
139.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
139.24: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

140.1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
140.2: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
140.3: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
140.4: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
140.5: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
140.6: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
140.7: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
140.8: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
140.9: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
140.10: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
140.11: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
140.12: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
140.13: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

141.1: A Psalm of David.I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
141.2: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
141.3: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
141.4: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
141.5: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
141.6: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
141.7: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
141.8: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
141.9: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
141.10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

142.1: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
142.2: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
142.3: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
142.4: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
142.5: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
142.6: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
142.7: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.

143.1: A Psalm of David.O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
143.2: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
143.3: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
143.4: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
143.5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
143.6: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
143.7: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
143.8: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
143.9: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
143.10: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
143.11: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
143.12: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.

144.1: Of David.Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
144.2: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
144.3: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
144.4: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
144.5: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
144.6: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
144.7: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
144.8: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
144.9: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
144.10: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
144.11: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
144.12: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
144.13: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
144.14: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
144.15: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.

145.1: A Psalm of praise. Of David.I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
145.2: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
145.3: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
145.4: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
145.5: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
145.6: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
145.7: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
145.8: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
145.9: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
145.10: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
145.11: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
145.12: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
145.13: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
145.14: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
145.15: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
145.16: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
145.17: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
145.18: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
145.19: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
145.20: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
145.21: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.

146.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
146.2: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
146.3: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
146.4: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
146.5: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
146.6: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
146.7: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
146.8: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
146.9: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
146.10: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!

147.1: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
147.2: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
147.3: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
147.4: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
147.5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
147.6: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
147.7: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
147.8: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
147.9: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
147.10: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
147.11: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
147.12: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
147.13: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
147.14: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
147.15: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
147.16: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
147.17: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
147.18: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
147.19: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
147.20: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!

148.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
148.2: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
148.3: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
148.4: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
148.5: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
148.6: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
148.7: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
148.8: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
148.9: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
148.10: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
148.11: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
148.12: young men and maidens, old and young together.
148.13: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
148.14: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!

149.1: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
149.2: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
149.3: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
149.4: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
149.5: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
149.6: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
149.7: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
149.8: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
149.9: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!

150.1: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
150.2: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
150.3: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
150.4: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
150.5: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
150.6: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!

1.1: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
1.2: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
1.3: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
1.4: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
1.5: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
1.6: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

2.1: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
2.2: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
2.3: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
2.4: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
2.5: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
2.6: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
2.7: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
2.8: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
2.9: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
2.10: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
2.11: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
2.12: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

3.1: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
3.2: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
3.3: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
3.4: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
3.5: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
3.6: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
3.7: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
3.8: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

4.1: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
4.2: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
4.3: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
4.4: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
4.5: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
4.6: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
4.7: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
4.8: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

5.1: To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
5.2: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
5.3: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
5.4: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
5.5: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
5.6: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
5.7: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
5.8: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
5.9: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
5.10: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
5.11: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
5.12: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

6.1: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
6.2: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
6.3: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
6.4: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
6.5: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
6.6: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
6.7: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
6.8: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
6.9: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
6.10: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

7.1: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
7.2: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
7.3: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
7.4: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
7.5: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
